projects.title: LoopGen For Runners
projects.description: This project builds an adaptive running-music system that predicts a runner's future speed using physiological data and generates loopable music synchronized to the predicted BPM.
projects.tech: Python, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Networks, Regression model

projects.title: Floating Water Exploration Device
projects.description: A device that allows users to explore water bodies by floating on the surface. It is equipped with a camera and a Raspberry Pi to capture images and videos of the water body.

projects.title: UCSD Event Finder Website
projects.description: A website that allows users to find events at UCSD. It is built with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

projects.title: Smart Glasses
projects.description: Wearable device with real-time image translation and navigation using Python and GCP. This project translates signs in real time and helps users navigate foreign cities.
